_doc: Setup-schema coverage ratchet (test-setup-schema-coverage.sh): every fleet app item fleet-config.json classes config or secret must name the declared store that carries it (`store`) or how it comes back (`via: install | connect`), so Cloud Account's Fleet Setup (libs:account SetupPlan over the declared stores and bundle routes) can place it and Profiles > Apps can show its state. An item that has neither is a setting Cloud Account cannot set up yet. Each one is listed here, by `<app id>/<item id>`, with the reason; the tester fails on a gap that is not listed (name it or fix it), on a listed gap that no longer exists (stale: delete it) and on Cloud Chat (fixed 2026-10-14: chat_setup). The list only shrinks.
code/editor-config: Acode keeps it in the WebView's localStorage / files: no SharedPreferences store the setup contract can write; needs a native helper first.
code/projects: Acode keeps it in the WebView's localStorage / files: no SharedPreferences store the setup contract can write; needs a native helper first.
code/chat-config: Acode keeps it in the WebView's localStorage / files: no SharedPreferences store the setup contract can write; needs a native helper first.
matrix/matrix-session-db: Element X keeps the session (homeserver, user id, tokens) in an SQLDelight database: the contract has no `room`/`sqldelight` handler yet (fleet-config.json kinds).
news/news-sources-json: the news engine holds sources and topics in its own files: no declared store yet.
